visualCharacteristics.purpose: Highlighted callout inside an article body: key takeaways panel, chart panel, or a ruled closing section
visualCharacteristics.description: Default: #e6f0fa panel, 40px padding, 20px gap, heading Neulis Sans 500 28px/36px, disc list Compatil Fact 20px/28px. chart: #f3f3f3 panel, 30px padding, title 30px/36px, subtitle 20px/25px, bold label 600 20px/25px, full-width chart image, 11px/15px disclaimer note. rule: no panel, 3px #e4761b top rule, 40px vertical padding, heading 42px/50px, text 18px/25px.

contentPattern.description: H2 'Key takeaways' + 3-item bullet list | H3 'Savings Unlocked' + subtitle + bold label + chart image + disclaimer | H2 'The bottom line' + paragraph
contentPattern.structure: row 1: rich text (heading, paragraphs, list; a fully bold paragraph is a label); row 2: optional image; row 3: optional note shown below the image. An image authored inside the text also works: content after it becomes the note.
rows: Rich text: heading, paragraphs and/or list

usage: Article body callouts: key takeaways summary, chart/infographic panel with disclaimer, closing 'bottom line' section.
reuseGuidance: Default for a light-blue summary panel (heading + bullets). Use chart for a grey panel holding a chart image with title, subtitle, bold label and disclaimer note. Use rule for a closing section separated by an orange top rule.
